records.learning_focus: Build, trace, debug and explain working systems.
records.recommended_sequence: Worked code/pseudocode → trace a small case → modify one condition → build independently → test edge cases.
records.method_profile: Use executable or hand-traced examples, incremental construction, debugging logs and test-driven checks.
records.boundary: Do not confuse code that runs once with a correct, secure or maintainable solution.

records.learning_focus: Make and defend decisions under uncertainty using customer, value and operating evidence.
records.recommended_sequence: Define a real problem → identify assumptions → gather small ethical evidence → compare options → run a bounded experiment → review outcome.
records.method_profile: Use case comparisons, customer-interview roleplay, assumption maps, simple unit economics and post-experiment reflection.
records.boundary: Do not infer market demand from compliments, friends or a single sale; separate evidence from enthusiasm.

records.learning_focus: Understand physical systems through models, diagrams, measurements and safe supervised experiments.
records.recommended_sequence: Model circuit → predict → calculate → simulate or inspect a safe low-voltage example → measure with suitable supervision → explain discrepancy.
records.method_profile: Use circuit diagrams, worked calculations, prediction-before-measurement, simulation and fault diagnosis.
records.boundary: No mains electricity, exposed high-energy sources, unsafe battery handling or unsupervised hazardous builds.

records.learning_focus: Interpret quantities, incentives, uncertainty and trade-offs with transparent assumptions.
records.recommended_sequence: Define question → identify units/time horizon → calculate or model → stress-test assumptions → interpret limits → communicate decision.
records.method_profile: Use worked numerical examples, spreadsheets or paper ledgers, scenario comparisons, estimation and error checks.
records.boundary: Do not treat classroom models as personalised financial, legal or investment advice; local rules and risk matter.

records.learning_focus: Explain biological structures and functions using accurate models, evidence and careful boundaries.
records.recommended_sequence: Locate structure → learn function → trace mechanism → compare normal variation → apply to a case → state uncertainty and care boundary.
records.method_profile: Use labelled diagrams, retrieval sketches, causal chains, case vignettes and teach-back.
records.boundary: No diagnosis or treatment from study exercises; use qualified clinical guidance for personal health.

records.learning_focus: Evaluate behavioural claims, mechanisms and decisions without overgeneralising from anecdotes.
records.recommended_sequence: Define construct → distinguish observation/inference → inspect study design → consider alternatives → apply cautiously → state limits.
records.method_profile: Use claim-evidence tables, experimental-design critique, scenario comparisons and confidence calibration.
records.boundary: Avoid diagnosing self or others; avoid stereotyping and causal claims from correlational evidence.

records.learning_focus: Develop visual judgement and design control through deliberate making, comparison and critique.
records.recommended_sequence: Observe reference → isolate one visual variable → make variants → compare against criteria → revise → explain design choices.
records.method_profile: Use side-by-side exemplars, thumbnails, visual analysis, constrained iterations and critique rubrics.
records.boundary: Do not treat taste as objective fact; separate intended effect, audience/context and craft criteria.

records.learning_focus: Design repeatable processes that reduce friction while preserving quality and humane limits.
records.recommended_sequence: Observe workflow → identify bottleneck → map steps → change one variable → measure effect → document and review.
records.method_profile: Use process maps, time/effort logs, checklists, small experiments and after-action reviews.
records.boundary: Do not equate busyness or tracking volume with meaningful output; protect rest and privacy.

records.learning_focus: Build expressive skill through observation, technique, variation and reflective iteration.
records.recommended_sequence: Study exemplar → isolate technique → imitate a bounded element → create variation → critique → produce original work.
records.method_profile: Use demonstrations, short focused drills, reference studies, iterative drafts and portfolio comparison.
records.boundary: Do not mistake copying an exemplar for original authorship; respect rights and attribution.

records.learning_focus: Acquire movement skills through safe, progressive practice and evidence of execution quality.
records.recommended_sequence: Understand cue → demonstrate slowly → practise manageable repetitions → vary context gradually → recover → review technique.
records.method_profile: Use demonstration, low-risk technique drills, short feedback loops, video only with consent and safe constraints.
records.boundary: No pain-through-it rule, maximal loading, unsafe contact or unsupervised high-risk drills; age-appropriate coaching.

records.learning_focus: Develop expressive and technical performance through focused rehearsal, listening and feedback.
records.recommended_sequence: Hear/observe model → isolate component → practise at manageable intensity → combine → record/reflect → perform varied form.
records.method_profile: Use model listening, chunked rehearsal, self-recording with consent, targeted repetition and performance reflection.
records.boundary: Avoid vocal strain, unsafe breath-holding or forced range; stop if pain/hoarseness persists.

records.learning_focus: Build conceptual models, procedural fluency and problem selection rather than memorising isolated steps.
records.recommended_sequence: Interpret representation → study worked example → explain why each step is valid → solve faded example → mix problem types → verify.
records.method_profile: Use multiple representations, worked examples, self-explanation, error analysis, retrieval and carefully timed interleaving.
records.boundary: Do not interleave before basic methods are understood; distinguish arithmetic slips from conceptual errors.

records.learning_focus: Understand systems and threat models through authorised, isolated and defensive practice.
records.recommended_sequence: Define asset/threat → learn concept → inspect safe toy example → practise in sandbox → document finding → explain mitigation.
records.method_profile: Use threat models, network diagrams, controlled labs, command tracing and defensive case analysis.
records.boundary: Only systems and accounts owned or explicitly authorised; no credential theft, malware deployment or real-target probing.

records.learning_focus: Acquire usable language through meaningful input, retrieval, interaction and corrective feedback.
records.recommended_sequence: Comprehensible input → notice form/meaning → retrieve vocabulary/chunks → use in context → receive correction → revisit after delay.
records.method_profile: Use spaced lexical retrieval, listening/reading, shadowing at safe pace, sentence generation and communicative tasks.
records.boundary: Do not overfocus on isolated word lists; accent identity is not a proxy for communicative competence.

records.learning_focus: Form answerable questions and build defensible claims from traceable evidence.
records.recommended_sequence: Frame question → search strategically → assess source → extract claim/evidence → corroborate → synthesise with uncertainty.
records.method_profile: Use search logs, source matrices, claim-evidence-reasoning, counter-source checks and synthesis outlines.
records.boundary: A source existing is not corroboration; disclose uncertainty, provenance and limits.

records.learning_focus: Learn safe everyday procedures through demonstration, checklists and context-sensitive judgement.
records.recommended_sequence: Clarify task and risk → observe trusted demonstration → rehearse with support → perform bounded step → verify → know when to ask.
records.method_profile: Use checklists, scenario rehearsal, teach-back, supervised practice and emergency-stop recognition.
records.boundary: High-stakes household, medical, electrical, legal or emergency actions require adult/qualified guidance.

records.learning_focus: Coordinate people and work through clear goals, communication, feedback and ethical decision-making.
records.recommended_sequence: Clarify shared goal → map stakeholders → agree roles → practise communication → review outcomes and impact → adapt.
records.method_profile: Use role-play, decision logs, meeting simulations, feedback rehearsal and after-action reviews.
records.boundary: Do not confuse authority with competence; include consent, fairness, power differences and accountability.

records.learning_focus: Communicate for a defined audience and purpose with evidence, structure and responsive listening.
records.recommended_sequence: Analyse audience/purpose → outline claim → select evidence → draft/perform → test comprehension → revise.
records.method_profile: Use exemplars, audience analysis, oral rehearsal, argument maps, peer response and revision cycles.
records.boundary: Persuasion quality is not truth; assess evidence, fairness and audience understanding separately.
